family_reports.body: My custody time was decreased due to lack of investigative efforts by CPS and GAL, resulting in progressive and ongoing psychological and physical harm being inflicted upon my children.

The only power I truly have, is that over myself, and lucky for me, and you, we can choose peace NO MATTER WHAT ANYONE ELSE IS CHOOSING. Make your reality what you want it to be, once choice at a time.

I am an adult, and in no way a victim. However, I have had to watch my child suffer at the hands of people that are in no way shape or form doing it for the "best interest of the child". Alienation, abduction, lack of education, psychological abuse, financial abuse, reactive abuse, and a situation where the child almost lost their life.
Wore out. Detrimental to children’s mental, emotional, psychological health by ignoring what’s best for the children.
My life revolves around soul crushing court ordered abuse. My child has been legally kidnapped to our abuser.

My children’s childhood was stolen from them. They were taken on false allegations over 3 years. Which were all determined unsubstantiated- they still have not returned home. They have been withheld court ordered therapy treatment for 3 years with no enforcement that could help them heal

public_comments.comment_text: This lady is oblivious to evidence, psychology, and anything relevant to a "child's best interest". What a disgrace to family law...period. She has allowed numerous court ordered violations, that literally show the mental issues with the other parent, which were discussed and she literally tried to make me the perpetrator. That was the end of it for me, I have gone 100% gray rock for all the people involved except the child. I really hoped for one non-corrupt person in all this, but I literally found none other than my own attorney at the time.
public_comments.author: Anonymous parent

public_comments.comment_text: Never met with the primary custodial parent of 12 years nor was that parent given the opportunity to submit evidence. She knew no one in the hallway when we finally got a hearing after the children were removed. She didn’t know the children’s teachers, coaches or counselors. She even attempted to intimidate a witness in the hallway, the school counselor. She then recommended the children and family to see a therapist that was not properly licensed.
public_comments.author: Anonymous parent

public_comments.comment_text: Spoke to me for only 15 minutes. Made a court recommendation based on this single 15 minutes conversation. Never spoke to my child, and was seen in quiet conversation with my ex’s new wife in the court room during a recess. I am fairly convinced that Bethany and ex’s wife are somehow related.
public_comments.author: Anonymous parent

public_comments.comment_text: Bethany Roberts failed to properly investigate my concerns, dismissed allegations of abuse without meaningful inquiry, and accepted my abuser’s denials at face value, which further harmed and divided my family.
